leases.spec: Implement `finalize` and `verify_executable` per the module docs (PG `setrefs.c`). Design: scans translate their own quals against THEIR OWN `vars` (no rt_index anywhere in plan nodes: rt indexes restart per query level and self-joins share OIDs; never key state by rt_index); after translating a node and its children, delete `Project` nodes whose exprs are exactly `InputRef(0..n)` over a child of width n (identity elision, keep the Project's `out` names). Do not compute `needed` masks (leave all-true). A recursive function `fix_node(node: &mut PlanNode, ...)` processes the node's expressions with a closure built from the CHILD's `vars` (a `Vec<BoundExpr>`) via `BoundExpr::transform_down`-style top-down matching: at each subtree first test structural equality against every child var (hash/linear scan is fine), replace by `InputRef(i)`; otherwise recurse. Joins: concatenated vars (outer ++ inner) for join quals; separate for key lists. Make a single helper `for_each_expr_mut(node, f)` over every expression field of every `NodeKind` (exhaustive match). SubPlan bodies and CTE bodies: finalize recursively with their own `vars` trees (`Plan.subplans`, `Plan.ctes`). Clear `vars`/`ordering` at the end.
